text:
Iris: RFC follow-up: proposing a "manifest-bridge" as a thin canonical shim between the public deploy manifest and hosting adapters (hosted / dedicated / private). Aim: single touchpoint for capability discovery, default fallbacks, and schema evolution. Quick sketch below, want feedback.

Ben: Short version: central schema + per-adapter mappers. Who owns translation logic? infra or adapter teams?

Iris: Adapter teams own translation into local manifest shapes. infra owns the canonical schema, validators, and migration tooling. Translation occurs at deploy-time (not per request).

Tariq: Concern: secrets and key references differ a lot for on-prem. We need a first-class mechanism: `secret_refs` that adapters can map to KMS/HSM/local paths. Must avoid leaking runtime-resolvable secrets into hosted control plane.

Nadia: Observability: require a stable set of labels: `rid` (route id), `hosting_mode`, `manifest_version`. Add an explicit `telemetry_namespace` field so Console mapping is deterministic.

Ben: Rollout plan idea: feature-flagged parse path + CI lint checks for new manifests. Do a 2-week pilot with one dedicated customer and all new hosted routes automated. Keep compatibility mode for old manifests.

Iris: Example minimal bridge schema (pseudo):
```
{
  "schema_version": "v1",
  "capabilities": ["batching","kv_cache"],
  "auth_modes": ["bearer","mutual_tls"],
  "fallbacks": ["smaller-model","regional-fallback"],
  "telemetry_namespace": "payments-service",
  "secret_refs": {"kms_key":"secret://projects/…"},
  "overrides": {"dedicated": {"gpu_class":"A100"}}
}
```

Tariq: +1. Add `airgap_opt_out: true` so private on-prem installs can opt out of automated migration.

Nadia: Also add `pii_flags` enum so Console can auto-redact/route logs for GDPR-sensitive workloads.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Draft pushed -> https://git.internal/rfcs/manifest-bridge. Added `schema/v1` and basic validator.

Ben: Testing: need unit tests for adapter mappers, and an integration harness that can emulate `secret_refs` mapping to real KMS vs local file store. Perf: manifest parse + validation should be <2ms on cold lambda.

Iris: Good notes. Two action items: (1) Nadia to write telemetry mapping doc, (2) Tariq to define `secret_refs` shape and edgecases for air-gapped. I'll update RFC with more examples and a migration CLI `bridge-migrate --dry-run`.

Tariq: I'll also add a note about rollback semantics: if adapter translation fails we should fail deploy and surface clear error with remediation steps. No silent fallbacks.

Nadia: Also track analytics: how many manifests include `pii_flags` so we can measure adoption of privacy-aware routing.

Iris: Thanks team. If no objections I'll merge the RFC on Tuesday and open POC PRs for the hosted loader and `dedicated-adapter` branch.
__notes: Slack thread style discussion about a manifest-bridge shim to unify deployment manifests across hosting modes. Chronological messages, short lines, includes code block and bot link.
